verdict.rationale: Discord documents official first-party SDKs. The Embedded App SDK supports shipping web apps and games inside Discord. The Discord Social SDK has getting-started guides for C++, Unity, Unreal Engine and iOS/Android. Missing for 10: an official SDK for bots and the general REST/Gateway API in mainstream languages (e.g. JS/Python) is not evidenced, there is no published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Our Embedded App SDK makes it quick and easy to ship native web apps, games, and interactive experiences.
